title: Sebastian and the Machine
author: Wren Brightwater
blurb: Bram Galloway, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
